goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann Finanzierungswege (Eigen-/Fremdkapital) und Haftungsszenarien kritischer diskutieren.
reviewerModel: Codex; exact serving model identifier not exposed
aspectRatioDecision: Close native 16:9 landscape; no exception needed. Existing format not mechanically normalized.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: Two clearly distinct questions: inward financing flows from equity and outside capital versus which private/business assets may be exposed to liability. The large question-mark shield avoids incorrectly asserting that outside finance automatically protects private assets or that a particular legal form always grants limited liability.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px both panels, financing arrows, two purses and question-mark shield are identifiable; the two-question distinction remains legible. Mug and workshop slogans are optional.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px the equity/outside-capital labels and private/business asset labels are readable without dense case text.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: The owner faces the laptop screen hidden from the viewer; its visible logo is on the back. The open notebook is blank without actor-inverted text. The large panels are explanatory overlays rather than physical documents she is reading.
actualInspection.style: Friendly approachable comic raster, clear broad colors, large conceptual objects; no photorealistic or sterile technical restyling.

goalTextStatus: Current German competence unchanged in the E2 bilingual candidate; this image review does not attest the positive-evidence profile or bilingual description gate.
